tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: List the registered apps (app_id + name). Use this first to discover valid app_id values, then pass one to the other tools to scope results to a single product.

tools.name: list_subscriptions
tools.description: List subscriptions/registrations, newest first. Optionally filter by app_id, status, or payment_type. Returns metadata (email, status, plan, amounts). Use get_customer for a single user, or revenue_summary for totals.

tools.name: get_customer
tools.description: Look up a customer by email. Returns every subscription/registration for that email across apps (or within one app if app_id is given), with full detail: verification, plan, billing period, usage, refunds. Empty when the email is unknown.

tools.name: list_recent_payments
tools.description: List recent paid transactions (excludes free-tier rows), newest first, ordered by payment date. Optionally scope by app_id. Use to review recent sales activity. Amounts are in the transaction currency (cents).

tools.name: revenue_summary
tools.description: Revenue and subscriber summary in USD cents (normalized from each transaction currency). Returns latest_payments (the MOST RECENT payment summed per customer: a run-rate, NOT lifetime turnover, because amount_paid is overwritten on renewal), refunds, approximate MRR, active/trialing/paid counts, and

tools.name: revenue_by_app
tools.description: Per-app rollup in USD cents (latest_payments/refunded/MRR + paid customer count), largest refund-adjusted latest payments first. latest_payments sums the most recent payment per customer, so it is a run-rate and NOT lifetime turnover. No lifetime figure is available per app (accrual is recorded per

tools.name: list_referrals
tools.description: List referral records (who referred whom, reward coupon code, pending/rewarded status) with what the referred buyer paid, newest first. Use for working out creator commission: a one_time referredPaymentType means referredAmountPaidCents is the whole sale; for a recurring row it is the LATEST payment

tools.name: list_recent_cancellations
tools.description: Recently canceled paid subscriptions (excludes free rows), most recent cancellation first, with what each customer was paying. Use for churn review; list_subscriptions orders by signup date instead.

tools.name: list_coupons
tools.description: List discount coupons (code, percent off, expiry, max uses, use count, which paid tiers they apply to). Optionally scope by app_id and/or restrict to currently-active ones (not expired, not maxed out). Read-only: cannot create, edit, or delete coupons.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_subscriptions, get_customer, list_recent_payments, list_recent_cancellations, invite_to_coupon · Private data: revenue_summary, list_referrals, create_app_kit, list_plans, update_plan_pricing · Public sink: list_subscriptions, get_customer, revenue_summary, invite_to_coupon, plan_app_kit, create_app_kit · Destructive: revenue_summary, revenue_by_app, list_coupons, delete_coupon, bulk_delete_coupon, create_app_kit, list_plans, update_plan_limits, update_plan_meta, update_plan_pricing, archive_plan, setup_pricing_page.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_subscriptions, get_customer, list_recent_payments, list_recent_cancellations, invite_to_coupon · Private data: revenue_summary, list_referrals, create_app_kit, list_plans, update_plan_pricing · Public sink: list_subscriptions, get_customer, revenue_summary, invite_to_coupon, plan_app_kit, create_app_kit · Destructive: revenue_summary, revenue_by_app, list_coupons, delete_coupon, bulk_delete_coupon, create_app_kit, list_plans, update_plan_limits, update_plan_meta, update_plan_pricing, archive_plan, setup_pricing_page

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
